description: Defines the SudoCommand interface for sudo-related commands within the policies module, including related constants and inner JsonFields class for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: SudoCommand
classes.description: An interface defining sudo commands with type prefix, resource type, and methods to get resource path, type, and set headers, parameterized with a type extending itself.

classes.name: SudoCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: A static inner class containing JSON field definitions for policy ID and selected fields, used in SudoCommand implementations.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix string for sudo commands.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer indicating the resource path for sudo commands.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the command, used for request metadata.
